page.overview:
Who is Dongfang Shuo?

Dongfang Shuo wore a Daoist robe of lustrous hues, a bright silk sash tied around his waist, a silk head wrapping, and straw sandals.

When Sun Wukong came to Fanghu Mountain looking for Chong'en, Dongfang Shuo derided him as nothing but a thief. Chong'en told him off and made him fetch tea.
